subject: Discovery follow-up — pick 30min intro and stakeholder pairings
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up — pick 30min intro and stakeholder pairings

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for a productive call earlier — quick recap and two small asks so we can get the right folks on a short product intro (30 min):

Recap (1 line): You
re evaluating an inference stack to reduce latency and per-token cost for clinical summarization pipelines; primary constraints are HIPAA controls and predictable throughput.

Two asks:
- Which of these two stakeholder pairings should we invite?
  1) Product + Security (recommended for compliance-focused review)
  2) Engineering + Platform (recommended for performance/ops deep dive)

- Which of these 3 short windows next week works in your timezone (PST)?
  A) Tue 2/24, 10:00–10:30 AM
  B) Wed 2/25, 2:00–2:30 PM
  C) Thu 2/26, 11:00–11:30 AM

We
 keep the agenda to: 5m quick context, 15m product walk-through, 10m targeted questions & next steps. I
 include a one-pager (attached) and a short pre-demo checklist we ask customers to scan through.

Attachment: redwood-onepager.pdf

If you prefer, I can also send a Doodle. Let me know and I1 lock the invite.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0184

Appreciate the summary. Let

Availability: Wed 2/25, 2:00–2:30 PM PST (option B) works best for all of us.

One note: we operate in a VPC-restricted environment; please make sure the demo touches on private deployment options briefly.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: Wed 2/25 2:00–2:30 PM PST — Redwood intro (Engineering + Platform)

Perfect — locking this in. I
 like to confirm a couple of quick details before the call and share the invite:

Meeting: Redwood Inference — 30m intro (Engineering + Platform)
When: Wed, Feb 25, 2026 2:00–2:30 PM PST
Attendees (so far): Jonas Weber (Redwood), Priyom Das (Redwood, SE), Laura Bennett (Redwood, CS); Alicia Park, Tom Reed, Maya Lin (Nebula Health)
Agenda (brief):
- 5m context & objectives (Alicia)
- 15m product demo (Priyom will cover performance/ops features)
- 10m Q&A / next steps (include procurement/ops owners)

Notes/ask for the meeting:
- Alicia: could you confirm Tom and Maya have access to join from a laptop with screen sharing? We may need to run a short live perf example — if VPC access is restricted we can do a recorded sample and then discuss architecture specifics.
- Alicia: any additional internal security contacts to loop in for the compliance section?

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?action=TEMPLATE&id=abc123
Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (short: network hints + log snippet examples)

I
 also appreciate any particular perf targets you want us to surface during the demo (p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost targets).

See you on Wed,
Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Confirmed: Wed 2/25 2:00–2:30 PM PST — Redwood intro (Engineering + Platform)

Quick internal note: Alicia chose option B (Wed 2/25 2:00 PST) and wants to focus on VPC/private deployment discussion. Priyom, can you prepare a 15-minute demo that emphasizes:
- private deployment options (VPC & on-prem),
- throughput/latency knobs (batching, quant profiles),
- an example perf slide with p50/p95/p99 and token cost estimates for a summarization pipeline.

Laura, please attach a short post-demo recap template we can use to capture next steps and procurement signals.

I
 like the demo slide deck to include one concrete migration path (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and a short note on security integrations (KMS/HSM).

Thanks — I1 add both to the calendar event.

Jonas
